text.en:
The authority and functions of the National Cancer Control Center of the Department of Health
as promulgated by Department of Health Administrative Order No. 188-A, s. 1973, are hereby confirmed and
shall be expanded in scope in order to assume leadership in coordinating cancer control activities of other
government and private agencies to unify and render more effective their efforts and in order to avoid
overlapping and duplication of activities.

The National Cancer Control Center of the Department of Health, through its Director, shall,
whenever necessary, call meetings with the heads of all agencies involved in cancer work in order to render
advice and assistance in their respective activities thus helping them attain their objectives.

To carry out its expanded authority and function, the National Cancer Control Center of the
Department of Health, aside from its regular budget appropriation, shall be appropriated additional funds out
of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the year amounts of which shall be
determined by the Secretary of Health through the recommendation of the Director of the National Cancer
Control Center. The appropriation of additional funds for this purpose shall be made available the year
following the effectivity of this Decree.

Repealing Clause. Any provisions of the law, decree, order, rules or regulations inconsistent
herewith are hereby repealed, revised or amended accordingly.

Effectivity Clause. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 9th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-eight.
